rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a timetable showing when events or transport services occur.

example.english: I’m checking the bus timetable; the next bus leaves at three.
example.traditional: 我睇緊巴士時間表，下一班車三點開。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 gan2 baa1 si2 si4 gaan3 biu2 haa6 jat1 baan1 ce1 saam1 dim2 hoi1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a table of scheduled bus, train, flight, or other service departures and arrivals.

example.english: The bus stop has posted the latest timetable, so we can just follow it to catch the bus.
example.traditional: 巴士站貼咗最新嘅班次表，我哋照住佢搭車就得喇。
example.jyutping: baa1 si2 zaam6 tip3 zo2 zeoi3 san1 ge3 baan1 ci3 biu2 ngo5 dei6 ziu3 zyu6 keoi5 daap3 ce1 zau6 dak1 laa3
